Plot mosaic plots

Source: R/EXPLORE_DESCRIPTIVES.R
plot_mosaic.Rd

Plot mosaic plots

Usage

plot_mosaic(df, factor_index, base_size = 10, title = "")

Arguments

df

dataframe

factor_index

index of factors

base_size

base font size

title

plot title

Examples

plot_mosaic(df=mtcars,factor_index=8:9)
#> 
  |                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  |                                                                                                                                                                                              |   0%
  |                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  |===============================================================================================                                                                                               |  50%
  |                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  |==============================================================================================================================================================================================| 100%
#> $`vs am`

#> 
#> $`am vs`

#> 
plot_mosaic(df=mtcars,factor_index=9:10)
#> 
  |                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  |                                                                                                                                                                                              |   0%
  |                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  |===============================================================================================                                                                                               |  50%
  |                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  |==============================================================================================================================================================================================| 100%
#> $`am gear`

#> 
#> $`gear am`

#>
